{{Quote|Whatever the original Thrawn might have done, this particular being hasn't done anything wrong. Certainly nothing that deserves a summary execution.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Vision of the Future" />}}
Before the [[Thrawn campaign]] of [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] '''Mitth'raw'nuruodo''', [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "[[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]," sent a [[spaarti cloning cylinder]] to the [[Hand of Thrawn]] fortress on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nirauan/Legends|Nirauan]], storing a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of himself in the cylinder, hiding it in a secret chamber. Before leaving Nirauan to commence his campaign, Thrawn told his [[Empire of the Hand]] forces that if he was reported [[Death/Legends|dead]], he would return in ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. To accomplish that, Thrawn set up a timed system, which he reset every time he returned to the Hand of Thrawn, to awake his clone.

In 9 ABY, Thrawn's [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], [[Rukh/Legends|Rukh]], killed him, and the Grand Admiral's forces began to await the Chiss's return. [[19 ABY/Legends|Ten years later]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and former [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] [[Mission to Nirauan|infiltrated]] the Hand of Thrawn, discovering Thrawn's clone; however, several [[Sentry droid/Legends|security droids]] that were protecting Thrawn's clone attacked the pair, and the infiltrators were forced to destroy a wall that led to a [[Water/Legends|lake]], flooding the chamber and killing the clone.

==Biography==
===Thrawn's promise===
{{Quote|Oh, he'll return. He said he would, and he always kept his promises.|Admiral Voss Parck on Grand Admiral Thrawn, to Jedi Master Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade|<ref name="Vision of the Future" />}}
[[File:Thrawn-TCGboxart.png|thumb|right|300px|Grand Admiral Thrawn, the clone's template]]
By [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]],<ref name="TERC-TLC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'' to [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].</ref> [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Thrawn," a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sent a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of himself to his [[Hand of Thrawn]] fortress on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nirauan/Legends|Nirauan]]. Storing the clone in a [[spaarti cloning cylinder]] in one of the fortress's sublevels, the Grand Admiral wrapped his duplicate in [[nutrient tube]]s and [[Flash pumping|flash-learning]] cables to feed the clone and share his memories with them. The Grand Admiral also placed [[Ysalamiri/Legends|ysalamiri]], creatures that repelled [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], around the clone.<ref name="Vision of the Future" />

Setting up a [[Time/Legends|timed]] system to awake his clone in ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Thrawn told his forces, the [[Empire of the Hand]], that if he was ever reported [[Death/Legends|dead]], he would return in a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]].<ref name="Vision of the Future" /> In 9 ABY,<ref name="TERC-TLC" /> the Grand Admiral left Nirauan to begin his [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Thrawn's [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] [[Rukh/Legends|Rukh]] murdered the Grand Admiral during the campaign's [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|Battle of Bilbringi]].<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>

===Two Grand Admirals===
{{Quote|Though I imagine you'd have trouble convincing some people of that. Next question, then: do we leave him here to wake up normally and join our friends upstairs? Bearing in mind that they're not too happy with either us or the New Republic at the moment? Or do we see if we can speed up the growth process and take him back to Coruscant?|Mara Jade|<ref name="Vision of the Future" />}}
[[File:Vision_of_the_Future.jpg|thumb|left|Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade destroyed a wall that led to a lake, unleashing a wave of water that killed Thrawn's clone.]]
Ten years later, in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="TERC-VOTF" /> the clone was ready.<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref> [[Moff/Legends|Moff]]<ref name="Vision of the Future" /> [[Vilim Disra]]<ref name="Allegiance">[[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]</ref> hired the [[Con artist/Legends|con man]] [[Flim (Human)|Flim]] to pose as Grand Admiral Thrawn in an attempt to gain power in the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. Flim met with several Imperial and New Republic officials, and eventually, rumors of Thrawn's return reached the Empire of the Hand. Shortly after, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and former [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] [[Mission to Nirauan|traveled]] to Nirauan and infiltrated the Hand of Thrawn. They encountered the fortress's commander, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]], who revealed that he was going to share the Empire of the Hand's existence with the Imperial Remnant, as he believed the rumors of Thrawn's return to be genuine. Jade unsuccessfully attempted to convince Parck that doing so would be a bad idea, and the admiral's forces [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] her. However, Skywalker rescued her and fled, entering the chamber that housed Thrawn's clone. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and his companion discovered the clone and discussed what he would do when he woke up, contemplating the possibility of bringing him to the New Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to use Thrawn to defend the government from several threats from the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] Parck had mentioned. As the clone had not done anything that deserved an execution, they refused to kill him.<ref name="Vision of the Future" />

After Jade suggested they should learn how much time the clone needed before awakening, the pair set off a defense system, sending two [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]]-plated [[Sentry droid/Legends|sentry droids]] to confront the infiltrators. As the cortosis shut down their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] upon impact, they were forced to destroy a wall that led to a [[Water/Legends|lake]]; as a result, a wave entered the chamber and destroyed the droids and killed Thrawn's clone. The pair then escaped from the fortress and left Nirauan.<ref name="Vision of the Future" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|No. It couldn't be. We destroyed that clone, remember?''"<br />"''We destroyed ''a'' clone. But who's to say he didn't have another one stashed away somewhere?''"<br />"''No. It's impossible. If there was another clone of Thrawn running around, we would have heard about it by now.''"<br />"''Would we? Remember, according to Parck, the only reason Thrawn came back to attack the New Republic in the first place was to whip us into fighting shape for some danger looming out there at the edge of the galaxy. Maybe he figures we're as ready as we're going to be and has decided to concentrate on clearing out some of the local troublemakers from his own backyard.|Jedi Master Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade Skywalker|<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>}}
[[File:OutboundFlightRuins.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Luke Skywalker told Mara Jade that they had killed Thrawn's clone after the former Emperor's Hand speculated that another clone of Thrawn had developed Formbi's plot to eradicate the Vagaari (pictured).]]
In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="TERC-SQ">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' to [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]].</ref> Chiss [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]] "Formbi" [[Expedition to Outbound Flight|brought]] Skywalker, Jade, and a group of [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], who had attacked the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] and the Chiss for years, to the Unknown Regions [[The Redoubt/Legends|Redoubt]] [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]]. He showed them the remains of ''[[Outbound Flight]]'', a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] Thrawn [[Battle for Outbound Flight|destroyed]]<ref name="SQ" /> in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]]<ref name="TERC-OBF">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> in an attempt to prompt the Vagaari to attack the Chiss to justify a [[Third Vagaari War|war]] against them. Formbi's plot was successful, and the Vagaari [[Battle of the Redoubt|attacked]] the Chiss and they were subsequently [[Attack on the Vagaari|defeated]] by the Chiss forces. After the events in the Redoubt, Jade doubted that Formbi had created the plan, speculating that a clone of Thrawn was eliminating the Unknown Regions' threats before<ref name="SQ" /> [[Yuuzhan Vong|another threat]]<ref name="OBF">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref> attacked [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Skywalker reminded her that they had destroyed Thrawn's clone, and Jade countered that Thrawn could have stored another clone of himself somewhere.<ref name="SQ" />

The circumstances of the clone's death were later covered in the [[Historical Council|New Republic Historical Council]] document ''[[The Essential Chronology]]'',<ref name="TEC" /> released just before [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY's]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. A [[36 ABY]] updated edition of the document, ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' also covered his death.<ref name="TNEC" />

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of Grand Admiral Thrawn, they were a male Chiss who stood at 1.8 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="Height" /> The Grand Admiral's clone had<ref name="Vision of the Future" /> [[Color/Legends|blue-black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]],<ref name="TNEC" /> and blue skin.<ref name="Vision of the Future" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|He'll presumably have all of Thrawn's memories. But will he have his genius, or his leadership, or his single-minded drive? I don't know.|Jedi Master Luke Skywalker.|<ref name="Vision of the Future" />}}
Master Skywalker did not know if the clone would have Thrawn's genius, leadership, or his single-minded drive.<ref name="Vision of the Future" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mitth'raw'nuruodo's clone first appeared in the [[1998]] novel ''[[Vision of the Future]]'', the final installment of [[Timothy Zahn]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Hand of Thrawn Duology]]''.<ref name="Vision of the Future" /> The clone was first pictured in the reference book ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', published in [[2005]]. The clone's illustration was drawn by [[Tommy Lee Edwards]].<ref name="TNEC" />
